grade <- c(82,56,72,88,65,85,81,68,85,96, 72,85,72,68,95,81,71,68,55,91)#每班10位同學, 2門學科(Math first then R)
Math_R.Matrix <- matrix(grade,c(10,2)) #每班10位同學, 2門學科, 1個班級，by column (Math first then R)；matrix
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Names of column and row for the object "Math_R.3Array.2Class"
colnames(Math_R.Matrix) <- c("Math","R")
rownames(Math_R.Matrix) <- c("ID1","ID2","ID3","ID4","ID5","ID6","ID7","ID8","ID9","ID10")
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Matrix --> factor(ordered=TRUE)； 
# A>90, 80<=B<90, 70<=C<80, 60<=D<70, F<60； A>B>C>D>F
Math_R.factor <- factor(Math_R.Matrix, levels=c("F","D","C","B","A"), ordered=TRUE)
Math_R.factor

#執行結果如下

Levels: F < D < C < B < A

messages.subject: Re: factor只能用在vector? 能適用於matrix與 array嗎?
parts:
Hi Tearice,

vector, matrix, array 資料型態須一致, 本例可使用 data.frame 即每行資料型態可不相同, cut 可將數值轉換為 factor, apply 可以取出每列資料, 進行 cut 轉換.


# title: 資料轉換為區間
# date: 2017.2.18

# vector, matrix, array 資料型態須一致
# data.frame 每一行資料型態可以不相同
# cut 可將數值轉換為factor

grade <- c(82,56,72,88,65,85,81,68,85,96, 72,85,72,68,95,81,71,68,55,91)
grade.df<- data.frame(matrix(grade, ncol=2))
colnames(grade.df) <- c("Math","R")
rownames(grade.df) <- c("ID1","ID2","ID3","ID4","ID5","ID6","ID7","ID8","ID9","ID10")

score <- as.data.frame(apply(grade.df, 2, function(x) cut(x, 
                                                          breaks = c(-Inf, 60, 70, 80, 90, Inf), 
                                                          labels = c("F", rev(LETTERS[1:4])), 
                                                          right = TRUE)))

grade.df.final <- cbind(grade.df, score)
grade.df.final
str(grade.df.final)
# end
